whyBatumi.title: Why Choose Batumi for Life & Business
whyBatumi.subtitle: A modern, comfortable environment for entrepreneurs, remote professionals, and families who value stability, freedom, and international opportunities.
whyBatumi.tagline: Batumi - the ideal balance of freedom, stability, and growth

items.title: Tax Advantages
items.text: One of the most favorable tax regimes in the region. Individual entrepreneurs pay just 1%, enabling efficient business development with minimal burden.

items.title: Free & Open Internet
items.text: Fast, stable internet with zero blocks. Telegram, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook - all work without restrictions or VPN.

items.title: Modern Education
items.text: European-standard schooling, instruction in English and German, Bologna system. No ideological pressure.

items.title: Easy Residency & Visas
items.text: The residency permit process is straightforward. Georgian residency also keeps the door open for Schengen visa applications.

items.title: Banking Infrastructure
items.text: Foreigners can open accounts and get Visa and Mastercard cards. Simple for working with international partners and clients.

items.title: Transport Connectivity
items.text: Batumi Airport operates reliably with direct flights to Europe and the CIS. Solid logistics, no disruptions.

items.title: Sanction-Free Zone
items.text: International shipments, cross-border bank transfers, and global business - all without restrictions.

items.title: Crypto Flexibility
items.text: No strict bans on digital assets. Cryptocurrency can be used within the framework of current Georgian law.

faq.title: Buyers' Questions
faq.subtitle: A short guide to what a foreigner should know before buying in Georgia
faq.note: Tax and residence permit information is current as of November 2026 and is not a substitute for legal advice.

items.q: Can a foreigner buy property in Georgia?
items.a: Yes. Foreigners buy apartments, houses and commercial property on the same terms as Georgian citizens. The purchase is made with your international passport, and no residence permit is needed. There is one restriction - agricultural land, so for houses with a plot the land category is checked in the registry extract before the deal.

items.q: What costs are there besides the price?
items.a: In Georgia the buyer pays no purchase tax and no stamp duty. Registering ownership in the Public Registry costs 150 GEL for 4 business days, 270 GEL for 1 day, or 350 GEL for same-day registration. You may also need the services of a translator and a notary.

items.q: Can I buy without coming to Batumi?
items.a: Yes. We'll show you the property by video call, and the deal can be completed by your representative under a notarized power of attorney. A power of attorney issued in another country usually needs an apostille and a translation into Georgian. We'll tell you the exact requirements for your country in advance.

items.q: Does buying property give you a residence permit?
items.a: The owner of property with a market value of more than 150 000 US dollars can obtain a short-term residence permit. This threshold has applied since 1 March 2026. The value is confirmed by a certified appraiser; the price in the contract is not used for this. The owner's spouse and children can obtain the same residence permit.

items.q: What taxes apply when renting out and when selling?
items.a: For long-term residential rentals, a private individual pays 5% of the rent. When selling a residential apartment or house, the tax is 5% of the difference between the sale price and the purchase price, and if the home was owned for more than 2 years, there is no tax. Different rules apply to hotel rooms and commercial property.

items.q: How can I view a property?
items.a: Every property on the site has a video tour. After that comes a viewing - in person in Batumi or by video call, at a time that suits you. Message us on Telegram or send a request on the property page.
